street-view-2022.title: Google Street View near 455 Industrial Avenue, April 2022

geometryNote: A short, approximate curb section begins at the photographed sign near 455 Industrial Avenue. It follows the sign arrow only; the next sign boundary is not surveyed.
restrictionNote: The user photo shows public two-hour parking, 8am–6pm Monday through Saturday, in the arrowed direction. A separate nearby photo shows commercial loading and no-parking signs; that direction is deliberately excluded from this public-parking section.

sections.splitBoundaryNote: The 2h sign's arrow points east. This maps only about one short curb segment east of the sign; do not infer the rule farther along Industrial Avenue.

spotChecks.finding: User photo shows P 2h, 8AM–6PM, Mon–Sat with an arrow east. The opposite direction has a no-parking sign. A separate nearby photo shows commercial loading 7AM–6PM Mon–Fri and a no-parking direction, neither of which is mapped as public parking.
spotChecks.scope: Only the arrowed, sign-adjacent portion is included. Adjacent industrial loading and temporary restrictions still control.
